name: City of Rye
gaps: No principal-building or total lot coverage limit in the residence schedule (only FAR and accessory rear-yard coverage); max_building_coverage left null
Min frontage and lot depth not set in Table A
Corner side yard is a formula (1/5 of lot width, capped at the front yard), so corner_side_ft is null
RFWP side/rear setbacks depend on the site's former zoning (60 ft ex-R-1 / 50 ft ex-R-2 for one-family); left null
R-3 to R-6 minimum lot is 1/2 acre in flood-hazard areas; FAR oversize bands computed from the non-flood minimum
No accessory apartment / ADU provision found in Ch. 197
RS: county lists a 1/3-acre minimum, which is the Table A row for other permitted uses; a single-family house needs 1/2 acre
RA-5 and RA-6 (senior apartments) not covered: not one-family districts
Accessory structure height limit not stated as feet (table heading says one-story accessory structures; Column 3 allows one- or two-story garages)

wetlands.summary: Ch. 195: 100 ft wetland/watercourse buffer; structures, grading, fill, vegetation removal and other regulated activities in a wetland, watercourse or buffer need a Planning Commission permit.

steep_slopes.summary: Ch. 166A: steep slope = contiguous area over 500 sf at 25%+ grade (min 10 ft horizontal); disturbing it needs Planning Commission steep slope work approval and a Building Inspector permit.

trees.summary: Ch. 187 (2023): Building Inspector permit to remove any protected tree (8 in.+ DBH) or significant tree (30 in.+ DBH) on private property; limited removals per 12 months, appeals to the Planning Commission.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 174: land development/redevelopment disturbing 300 sf or more needs a SWPPP and City Engineer review (disturbance under 100 sf exempt).

adu.summary: No accessory apartment provision found in the zoning chapter; residence districts allow up to two boarders/roomers without separate cooking facilities (Table A Column 3).

general.accessory_structures: One-story accessory structures may occupy a set share of the required rear yard (20-35% by district) and must keep the Table A side-line distance (5-20 ft); none within 3 ft of the rear line (§ 197-65) or in the required side yard within 75 ft of the street (§ 197-58); nothing in the front yard (§ 197-47).
general.pools: Outdoor pools and equipment: not in the required front yard; 20 ft from side and rear lines in R-1, 15 ft elsewhere; screened and fenced 4 ft; 25 ft from septic (Table A Column 3(9)(b)).
general.notes: FAR counts attics over 7 ft headroom at 50%, rooms over 14 ft high twice, exposed basements at 25% (§ 197-43.2). First floor of new one-family homes max 3 ft above preexisting grade (§ 197-46.1). Height measured to the mean of eaves and ridge for pitched roofs. Front setback may be reduced to the average of existing buildings within 100 ft (§ 197-48). Yards on streets under 50 ft wide are measured from a line 25 ft from the centerline.

R-1.name: One-Family Residence (1 acre)

max_floor_area.note: § 197-43.1: FAR halves on the part of the lot between 150% and 250% of the district minimum lot area, quarters above 250%. Attics >7 ft headroom count 50%, rooms >14 ft high count twice, exposed basements 25% (§ 197-43.2)

accessory.notes: One-story accessory structures may cover up to 20% of the required rear yard and must be 20 ft from side lines; not within 3 ft of the rear line (§ 197-65); within 75 ft of the street (or 75% of lot depth) they may not enter the required side yard (§ 197-58). No front-yard structures (§ 197-47).

R-1.source: § 197-86 Table A: Residence Districts Area, Yard, Height and Miscellaneous Regulations (Attachment 1); §§ 197-43.1, 197-58, 197-65
R-1.notes: Corner lots: corner side yard at least 1/5 of lot width at the building, need not exceed the front yard (Table A note (c)); owner may choose which street is the front (§ 197-52).

RFWP.name: Residential Floodplain and Wetland Preservation District

max_building_coverage.text: All buildings: 2,600 sf x approved dwelling units (formerly R-1) or 1,700 sf x units (formerly R-2)

max_floor_area.text: Site floor area <= 2.5 x the maximum permitted building coverage

RFWP.notes: Rezoned 10+ acre sites (25%+ wetland/flood hazard). Buildings 85 ft from streets; from all other lines 60 ft for a one-family house on former R-1 land (70 two-family, 85 apartments) or 50 ft on former R-2 land (60, 75). No buildings in the flood hazard area; lowest floor 2 ft above base flood; max 4 units per building.
